title: Filter hidden items, stealthed NPCs, and unmet stranger names in Mind Inspector _whatISeeHtml

sections.what: Align Mind Inspector's "What I see" card (_whatISeeHtml) with per-agent perception and fog-of-war masking rules so it stops exposing hidden items, stealthed NPCs, and unmet stranger names.
sections.why: static/js/inspector/mind-view.ts lines 857-870 renders `area.items` directly without filtering hidden items and iterates `worldState.players` without skipping `hidden`/`stealthed` actors or masking unmet strangers via `isKnownToViewer`/`anonymousName`, contradicting the Subjective Mind framing labeled "What I see - the room right now".
sections.how:
1. Update `_whatISeeHtml` in static/js/inspector/mind-view.ts (lines 857-872) to filter out `hidden` items (and respect darkness/lighting parity with PromptBuilder / room-context.ts).
2. Exclude players with `state === 'hidden'` or `'stealthed'` (or matching room visibility snapshot `players_in_area` when available) and format visible co-located strangers through `PromptBuilder.anonymousName` / `isKnownToViewer` so unmet real names are masked consistently with the character's Subjective Mind view.
3. Add JS unit coverage verifying hidden items, hidden NPCs, and unmet strangers do not leak in `_whatISeeHtml`.
sections.verify: 1. Run npm run build:ts and JS unit tests for InspectorMind asserting _whatISeeHtml hides concealed/hidden items, omits hidden/stealthed players, and masks unmet stranger real names.

acceptance.text: mind-view.ts _whatISeeHtml excludes hidden items and dim/unlit invisible objects matching room perception rules.
mind-view.ts _whatISeeHtml excludes hidden/stealthed players and masks unmet strangers using unknown_name / PromptBuilder.anonymousName instead of exposing real registry names.
Unit test covers hidden items, stealthed NPCs, and unmet strangers in _whatISeeHtml rendering.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Character Inspector -> Mind -> "What I see - the room right now" card (static/js/inspector/mind-view.ts).

Current availability: mind-view.ts _whatISeeHtml (lines 857-870) reads raw `area.items` and raw `Object.entries(worldState.players)` matching `current_area`, leaking hidden items, stealthed NPCs, and true names of unmet strangers.

Manual verification steps:
1. Place an unmet stranger, a hidden/stealthed character, and a hidden item in a character's room.
2. Open Character Inspector -> Mind and inspect the "What I see - the room right now" box.
   - expected: Hidden item and hidden/stealthed character are omitted, and the unmet stranger renders with their masked stranger label (unknown_name) rather than their true name.
